requirement: SRE and operations users shall be able to run cluster anomaly investigation workflows through cadctl, including handling alerts that a cluster has gone missing. The system shall detect cluster anomalies and communicate relevant investigation outcomes to cluster owners or related operations systems.

When investigation results require follow-up action, the system shall execute the applicable mitigation or disposition actions, including support-status updates, alert silencing or escalation, and recording of follow-up handling information in related operations systems.

The system shall receive external alert webhooks and initiate CAD checks through Tekton pipeline execution. Operators shall also be able to start a Tekton PipelineRun directly without a webhook, supplying a JSON payload containing the relevant alert or incident identifier.
CAD investigation, communication, and disposition workflows shall support interaction with PagerDuty, AWS, and OCM through the integrations available to cadctl.
The cadctl runtime shall be distributed as a container image based on UBI minimal, with the CLI executable available inside the image.
